reconciliation.reason: The current owner direction again requires expansion to 400 accepted/source-verified canonical questions. The prior 371 release cut was a time-to-release decision, not a demonstrated source-exhaustion finding: it explicitly closed new authoring for that release and skipped an additional residual scan. This newer owner direction supersedes that release cut and reopens Question Bank completion toward 400 without weakening any quality gate.
reconciliation.next_search_scope: Run a fresh post-371 residual gap audit across all second-class-applicable sections of the registered MLIT 第5版 source, then author only source-supported materially distinct propositions or controlled variants that survive full-canonical collision pre-screen.

authoritative_source.scope_rule: Use second-class-applicable material only; exclude subsections explicitly marked 〔一等〕.

priority: Tier B source-defined boundary or condition variants with materially different solving rules
Tier C materially distinct reasoning variants only after stronger Tier A/B opportunities are exhausted
expansion_policy.fourth_question_condition: The authoritative source explicitly defines at least four materially different states, conditions, exceptions, thresholds, or response branches and Director adjudication records why the fourth requires a distinct decision boundary or reasoning path.

hard_reject_rules: same answer-defining proposition with the same reasoning path and no material boundary change
unsupported inference beyond explicit source support
ambiguous or multiple defensible correct answers
incidental trivia with low exam/practice value
implausible distractors that do not represent credible misconceptions
candidate created solely to satisfy the numeric target
